source: data/concrete.csv (UCI Concrete Compressive Strength, Yeh 1998, CC BY 4.0)
analysis_unit: concrete mix: one of 8 levels for each of 7 components (kg/m3)

objectives.quality: 28-day compressive strength predicted by a monotone gradient-boosting surrogate (MPa, maximize)
objectives.cost: material cost with illustrative prices (US$/m3, minimize)

constraint: standardized distance to the nearest real mix <= 1.0
ground_truth: all 2,097,152 mixes scored once and cached, used only to measure the searches
metrics: hypervolume ratio to the true front
extra cost of the cheapest mix reaching 30/40/50/60 MPa
origin of each offspring (niche, other niche, all promising, uniform fallback)
share of generations in which two components share a block, against chance
damicore_roles: niches of promising mixes (one file per mix)
variable groups over all promising mixes
